A lane arrived from a lead, with the trail that led to it.

**Direction:** Chips → Harness  
**Sent by:** Chips only; refused from a client  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`run.requested.json`](/schema/run.requested.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"run.requested"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `lane_id` | yes | `string` | A lane identifier: `lane_` followed by a ULID. |
| `goal` | yes | `string` | What is being asked. |
| `constraints` | no | `string[]` | Bounds on how to do it. |
| `deadline` | no | `string` | When it is needed by. |
| `on_behalf_of` | yes | `string` | The person the work is ultimately for. |
| `requested_by` | yes | `string` | The lead that routed it. |
| `specialist_id` | yes | `string` | The harness this lane runs on, which the run in the envelope belongs to. A lead may name an ephemeral child, which Chips has minted by the time this arrives. |
| `agent_id` | no | `string` | The agent of that harness that works the lane (ADR 0087): its one agent in the lane's room, the one the lead named, a lead's hand-off to one of its own, or a child minted for this lane. |
| `trail` | yes | object[] | How the work got here. Lanes deeper than three are flattened into steps, not rejected. |
| `trail[].participant_id` | yes | `string` | Who handled this hop. |
| `trail[].run_id` | no | `string` | The run this hop belongs to. |
| `trail[].goal` | no | `string` | What was asked at this hop. |
| `autonomy` | yes | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3` | The level for this lane. |
| `link_to` | no | `string[]` | The lead spaces this lane is linked into, where its route card appears. |
| `origin` | no | `string` | The message that caused the routing, quoted in the specialist's task card. |
| `attachments` | no | object[] | Anything the specialist needs. |
| `attachments[].attachment_id` | yes | `string` | A attachment identifier: `att_` followed by a ULID. |
| `attachments[].filename` | yes | `string` | The name to show. Never trusted for its type. |
| `attachments[].mime_type` | yes | `string` | Sniffed from the bytes on upload, not taken from the client. |
| `attachments[].byte_size` | yes | `number` | Size in bytes. |
| `attachments[].sha256` | yes | `string` | Lowercase hex digest. The store is content-addressed. |
| `attachments[].width` | no | `number` | Pixels, for images and video. |
| `attachments[].height` | no | `number` | Pixels, for images and video. |
| `attachments[].duration_ms` | no | `number` | Milliseconds, for audio and video. |
| `attachments[].transcript` | no | `string` | What was said, for a voice note the server transcribed when it arrived (ADR 0054). Machine-heard: the person's words as best the server could make them out. |
| `attachments[].replaces` | no | `string` | The version of the room's file of this name that this one was made from (ADR 0099), from the post's `replaces`. Filled in by Chips; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `attachments[].url` | yes | `string` | A signed URL, bound to the requesting token: fetch it with that token as the bearer, since the URL alone is refused. |
| `attachments[].url_expires_at` | yes | `string` | Ten minutes from issue, by default (decision 10). |
| `label` | no | `string` | What the lead calls the specialist on this lane, when that is not its participant name: a Space's name, a subagent's type. |
